labels.absorbed_identical: E4 fingerprint identical to D's (equal cell histogram, area and cell count): the synthesizer already produces D's netlist (spec 04 §B step 2)
labels.duplicate: E4 fingerprint identical to an earlier candidate's of the same run (spec 04 §B step 3); never counted in the map
labels.retained: some component g > t_D and none < −t_D (rule A band; spec 04 §B step 4); on a spread / offset design a retained candidate must also beat the envelope of its own surface perturbations (arm M's extra check; the uniform caliber stops at rule A)
labels.absorbed: fingerprint converged at E4 with a lower rung where D reaches the candidate's PPA: rung attribution compares the candidate with D under the same rung (spec 04 §B step 5; Phase 4 objects only)
labels.noise: fingerprint not converged and every component within the band (step 6)
labels.harmful: some component g < −t_D and none > t_D (step 7); sub-label blocks_synthesis when the resource diff shows DesignWare / datapath extraction in D absent from C
labels.tradeoff: some component > t_D and some < −t_D, dimensions named (step 8)
labels.fragile: retained by rule A but not above the envelope of the candidate's own perturbations on a spread / offset design (arm M only)

definitions.rule_A: t_D = max(2.0 × σ_robust, the design's own max |δ| including P0, the pooled q90); designs without a measured floor carry the pooled minimum (floor_source pooled); frozen as floor_version phase4 (DECISIONS 2026-09-14, G4.3); gains relative to D: area and power relative, WNS in clock periods at Φ_main (src/diagnose/m3.relative_gains)
definitions.materiality: area 1 %, power 2 %, WNS 1 % of the period (config noise.materiality) — reported beside every retention figure, never used as a verdict
definitions.classes: rules v2 (src/classify/rules.py, spec 04 §A; docs/spec/04-classifier-diagnoser.md): (a) same registers and stored values; (b) latency-preserving refactor with unchanged register count; (c1) latency-preserving refactor with changed register count; (c2) output-timing change (latency mapping); (d) operator family gained (multiply / divide, add / subtract, variable shift in C's word-level RTLIL histogram absent from D's) or a longest-combinational-path ratio ≥ 3.0

summary: 1. **Supportable today.** The residual is defined against a measured floor: at E4 the pooled minimum is 0.28 % area / 2.2 % power / 0.03 % WNS of the period; 13 of the 30 Phase 5 designs carry the pooled floor (no measured perturbations at E4), 1 of the 30 is an offset design (mc_adr_sel; its 335 retained verdicts so far are flagged).

2. **Supportable.** The ladder is real but not monotone: E1 → E2 is the large step (−6 % to −37 % area on the probe), the high-effort flags are no-ops, DesignWare is a capability of its own (3–6 % either way), retiming and clock gating act only where their structures exist; D's area grows on 10 of 127 designs from E1 to E4.

3. **Supportable (interim).** Rule A at E4 on the Phase 4 B0 objects (10 human-written designs): 55 of 168 proven objects retained (32.7 %), 49 of them above the materiality threshold; map shape 'concentrated' (reports/phase4.md §2) with E4 retention by class a 6 %, b 49 %, c1 100 %, d 94 %.

4. **Supportable (interim, incomplete).** Phase 5 so far: 3771 of 11302 evaluated proven candidates retained (33.4 %), 3254 above materiality, across 13 tier-arm rows; the large tier's runs are done, the medium tier stands at 35 created, 297 done, 44 running (interim), B0's offline E4 is in for all but 146 proven B0 candidates.

5. **Supportable.** The literature's caliber: of B0's Yosys-'improved' candidates with an E4 record, 645 of 1490 are retained at E4 (43.3 %), 179 are absorbed_identical or noise, 183 harmful; on the literature pairs, RTL-OPT better at E1 20 → retained at E4 11 of 34 proven pairs, RTLRewriter 24 → 10 of 43; under the authors' released RTL-OPT setting (plain compile, 0.1 ns) reproduced on this DC 25 of 33 pairs are better, under the paper's described setting (compile_ultra, 1 ns) 13.

6. **Not yet.** Whether retained gains survive the hidden configurations (C1's certification column) — sealed until PHASE5_COMPLETE; the final map with rung attribution on Phase 5 candidates (Phase 6 ladder runs); the Dr.RTL per-design comparison (paper numbers not transcribed; the reference row not run); the large-tier M row (641 prescreened candidates await their proofs after the small tier).

7. **Not yet.** Retention on the proof-latency-bound and verification-limited designs (SPI, simple_spi, tv80, cpu; hsm): the proven denominators there are too small, and E1 (a) / (b) may still flip router's and tv80's v1-falsified records.

8. **Three items that would change the picture most.** (i) The hidden-layer column on the accepted candidates (turns visible retention into certified retention or not); (ii) the large-tier prescreened simulations, E4 and proofs plus E1 (a) / (b) (fills the large tier's M and Dr.RTL rows, the designs where the caliber argument is strongest); (iii) the Phase 6 ladder runs on the Phase 5 accepted candidates (rung attribution of what survives — today only the Phase 4 objects carry it).
